verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a zero retention policy covering inputs, outputs, and user data, backed by SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification, so retention is addressed by default. However, the evidence shows no user-facing controls for retention windows, opt-in or opt-out settings, or deletion requests, so the 'control' part of the story is not shown. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention settings, documented data deletion API or process, detailed retention policy terms, independent corroboration of zero retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: With our zero retention policy your inputs, your outputs, and your user data stay private. DeepInfra is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified.
